title: National Scholarship Portal – Merit-cum-Means Support
text: The scheme supports eligible students pursuing higher education. Eligibility is based on academic performance, institution conditions and annual family income limits stated in the current notice. Applicants submit identity, enrolment, bank and income documents through the official portal. The portal notice controls deadlines and renewal rules.

title: PM-KISAN Income Support
agency: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: The programme provides income support to qualifying farmer families subject to land and exclusion conditions in the current guidelines. Applicants use the official portal or designated facilitation centre and keep land records, identity and bank details ready. State verification and the latest government notice control payment status.

title: Udyam Registration and MSME Support
agency: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: Micro, small and medium enterprises can register through the official Udyam portal. The enterprise type, investment and turnover classifications are determined under the current notification. Registration can support access to selected credit, procurement and subsidy programmes, but each benefit has its own eligibility and application process.

title: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
text: The guarantee programme helps eligible lenders provide collateral-free credit to qualifying micro and small enterprises. The borrower applies through a member lending institution. Loan amount, borrower status, guarantee fee, repayment and exclusions follow the current scheme guidelines; the lender remains responsible for sanction and documentation.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
text: PM-JAY provides cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare coverage to eligible beneficiary families at empanelled hospitals. Eligibility and package coverage must be checked through the official beneficiary identification process. Carry the approved identity document and verify hospital network and pre-authorisation requirements before treatment.

title: NDMA Disaster Relief Guidance
text: Disaster relief assistance is administered under applicable national and state guidelines. Eligibility, damage assessment, responsible department and application channel vary by event. Citizens should follow the current district or state notice, preserve evidence of loss and use official emergency channels rather than relying on an informal summary.
